root.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Mieses Attack, Landau Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Bd3 Nf6 4. e5 Nfd7 5. e6

overview: In the Landau Gambit White plays 3.Bd3 Nf6 4.e5 Nfd7 5.e6, sacrificing a pawn to break up Black’s kingside. Black takes 5...fxe6 or 5...Nb6 and generally stands better, with White seeking pressure on the dark squares and Black’s king. The main branches are risky and generally considered unsound.

white_ideas.idea: Open lines with Qg4, Bxh7 ideas and quick development

black_ideas.idea: Take on e6 and consolidate, then play ...Nb6 or ...e5
Trade down the attack and use the extra pawn

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with Black’s e6 pawn removed from f7

character.notes: White sacrifices a pawn and plays for an attack. Sharp.

gambit.notes: Black can keep the pawn after 5...fxe6.

structure.notes: Pawn structure of d4/d5 and an open e- and f-file.

sublines_that_differ.name: Mieses Attack
sublines_that_differ.how: Without the e6 sacrifice White just plays e5 or exd5.
